nom: Baxter of California Herbal Mint Toner

avis.titre: The products are Great- On Him & in the Bathroom!
avis.texte: Yes they smell amazing and I will continue to order Baxter! For 2 Reasons- The smell is so clean & not heavy. 2. They display really nice- he uses the “Main Bathroom” & usually I’m pulling the shower curtain closed to hide products. NOPE- They are Clean looking, great bottles & very attractive packaging! Love this line!
I'm still lost on what toner does, but damn, it works. I use it right after washing my face (within 30 seconds), followed immediately by a moisturizer lotion. Great results.

avis.titre: Leaves face feeling clean and refreshed.
avis.texte: The Baxter of California Toner certainly does not look impressive in its plain blue and white bottle, but don’t let looks fool you; this is a quality product that feels good after each use. Shaving is not easy on our faces and a good toner certainly is useful to calm irritated skin. I take a cotton ball, as recommended on the bottle, squeeze some toner into the ball, and then, starting with my forehead, wipe my entire face and neck with the ball infused with toner. This toner has a mild and pleasant smell, at least for me. My wife did not like it much. It feels refreshing going on and leaves my face feeling clean and healthy. After going over my face and neck the first time, I went back with what toner was left in the cotton ball and massaged my nose and cheeks. A little of this toner does go a long way. Baxter tells us that this is a “gentle astringent for men with cucumber extract and antioxidants. The toner cleanses, tones and removes impurities from facial skin with mild herbal extracts. Antioxidants, Herbal Extracts and E protect skin against free radicals and cell damage, leaving your face looking fresh. Use after Daily Face Wash to prime skin before moisturizing, or throughout the day to remove excess oil.” Yes, readers, this sounds like advertising puffery to me as it does for you, but that said, I am still going to recommend this product. It works for me.

avis.titre: Cheep bottle packaging poor seal around cap, otherwise its a GREAT PRODUCT!
avis.texte: Great product, great results..(But hears the bad part)...with such a great product and such a expensive price, you think they would opp in for better packaging...i have purchased 2 bottles this past season and if you put them in your bag or back-pack or ect, the cap is lose!...they leak! All over you bag...please make sure the seal is tight and bottle is upright at all times otherwise it will leak all over the rest of you daily products & cloths!!!....reason i give 3 stars and not 5..the bottled packaging need a better seal or new bottle for secure travel.

avis.titre: First and only toner my husband will ever use!
avis.texte: My husband takes very good care of his skin but had never incorporated a toner into his skincare routine until I ordered this herbal mint toner from Baxter of California. He absolutely loves it and feels like it helps his skin absorb his face moisturizer much better after using it. Sometimes he'll apply the toner using cotton balls or pads, but oftentimes he'll even just apply this straight onto his face using his hands. 10/10 would recommend for picky husbands!
I use it daily and it revives me every time. Great smell and not drying to the skin. Highly recommend it.
I like it. Cools the skin down after shaving. Closes the pores well.
Love Baxter of California products love there sense of there products!

avis.titre: Takes time to get used to it
avis.texte: Trying for first time, this minty toner has an effervescent and tangy effect that caused redness and blotches on my face the first two times. Subsequent use reduces the impact. It's been about a week and no other side effects since. Face feels cleaned and refreshed and a good way to start the day.
Non ha profumo, e invece io puntavo su quello, o qualsiasi altra azione per cui è come passare sul viso un batuffolo di acqua...
This is a reasonably priced toner, suitable for men. I find it works well as part of my routine, and doesn't cost the Earth.
